profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Visa
profile.summary:
Over 20 years of experience in database development and administration with DBA duties.
• Hands on experience in Requirement analysis, developing, installing, configuring, managing, monitoring and troubleshooting in SQL Server versions 2012/2008/2005/2000.
• Well-versed with different stages of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
• Extensive experience in database design and applying normalization techniques. Communicating the new design or changes with different teams.
• Extensive experience with SQL Server and T-SQL in constructing ad-hoc queries, stored procedures, extended stored procedures, triggers, tables, user defined functions, views, indexes, user profiles, data modeling and data dictionaries.
• Extensive experience with monitoring, tuning, analyzing DB performance and allocating server resources to achieve optimum performance by performing various query-optimization techniques and tools Profiler, System Monitor, DTA and Execution plans.
• Good experience in implementing Database Mirroring, Service Broker, Log shipping, Replication, Database Snapshot, Linked Server, automated several tasks creating SQL Maintenance, Jobs and Alerts.
• Experience in creating SQL Logins, Roles and Authentication modes as a part of security policies for various categories of users.
• Experience in Extract, Transfer and Load (ETL) process using DTS and SSIS application tools and also possess a good knowledge in Database Migration.
• Experience in developing, configuring and deploying BI Projects using SSIS (Integration), SSRS (Reporting) and SSAS (Analysis) services.
• Good knowledge of RDBMS and Data Warehouse concepts: OLTP & OLAP.
• Experience in using DBCC commands to check the database consistency and integrity.
• Experience in using BCP and Bulk Insert commands and working with flat files
• Knowledge of implementing End-Points in SQL Server.
• Experience in designing, implementing, maintaining, and documentation of complex database applications.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer (Director)
positions.description: Lead and Architect Database development projects

positions.title: Lead Database Developer/DBA
positions.description:
• Requirement Analysis, Design, Develop, Install, Test, Tune, Configure, and Document Database Software Solutions in SQL Server 2012/2008.
• Develop synchronization between multiple databases, including mainframe and Microsoft SQL Server databases, as required.
• Create and maintain complex stored procedures, ad-hoc queries, and Transact-SQL, triggers, views, tables, indexes, user-defined functions, user profiles, data models and data dictionaries.
• Perform database administration duties such as implementation of database mirroring, service broker, log shipping, replication, database snapshot, end-points, linked servers, automate several tasks by creating SQL Maintenance, Jobs and alerts.
• Creating SQL Logins, Roles and Authentication modes as a part of security policies for various categories of users.
• Use Business Intelligence tools such as SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS), SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) effectively in the development, configuration, and deployment of database software solutions based on system requirements.
• Monitor, test, tune and analyze database software performance and allocate server resources.
• Perform extract, transform, and load (ETL) data migration services using Data Transformation Services (DTS) and SSIS.
• Experience migrating the data from SQL Server to Oracle database and verifying the migration.
• Consult with other team members to identify problems and create solutions.
Skills Used : SQL Server 2012/2008, SSIS, SSRS, SSAS, ETL, Win 7, Win Server, IIS, Oracle 9i/11.

positions.title: Sr Database Developer
positions.description:
• Requirement Analysis and creating database design using Normalization.
• Creating and maintain complex Stored Procedures, T-SQL, Extended SPs, Triggers, Views, Tables, User-Defined Functions, DBCC commands.
• Implemented Database Mirroring, Log Shipping and creating linked servers.
• Implemented SQL Logins, Roles and Authentication Modes as a part of Security Policies for various Categories of users.
• Prepared different types of reports using SSRS.
• Creating new SSIS packages and also upgrading DTS to SSIS packages.
• Performed daily tasks including Backup and Restore using scheduled SQL Jobs and alerts.
• Rebuild the database indexes at regular intervals for better performance.
• Knowledge of implementing SQL Server Service Broker.
• Troubleshoot system issues, performance tuning using SQL Server Profiler and Database Engine Tuning Advisor for performance purpose.
• Worked on the data warehouse design and analyzed various approaches for maintaining different dimensions and facts for warehousing application.
Skills Used : SQL Server 2005, SSIS, SSRS, Crystal reports, ETL, ISS
